text: # Call Transcript: Recharge Failure — Amount Debited, Not Credited **Document ID:** TRX_001 **Category:** C03 — Recharge & Payments **Department:** Finance **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-08-02 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base **Channel:** Voice (Call Centre) --- ## Conversation Agent: Thank you for calling NovaTel, this is Rhea, how may I help you? Customer: My recharge of ₹299 got debited but my plan hasn't started. Agent: I'm sorry for the inconvenience. May I have your registered mobile number and the transaction reference ID, please? Customer: It's 98XXXXXX21, and the reference is UPI2608091234. Agent: Thank you. I can see the transaction is showing as pending on our end. This can happen due to a brief delay with the payment gateway. It typically auto-resolves within 30-60 minutes. Customer: It's already been 3 hours. Agent: Understood, in that case I'll raise this for manual reconciliation right away. You'll receive an SMS update within 24 hours, and if it isn't auto-credited by then, the amount will be automatically reversed to your source account. Customer: Okay, thank you. Agent: You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today? Customer: No, that's all. Agent: Thank you for calling NovaTel, have a great day! Agent: Before we close this, can I just confirm the resolution has fully addressed your concern? Customer: Yes, that's sorted now, thank you. Agent: Perfect. I've added a note to your account and you'll also receive a confirmation SMS shortly. ## Diagnostic Notes (Internal) - Identity verified via
